parameters.name: AlreadyJoined
parameters.description: Specifies whether the current user has joined the workspace.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region in which the bucket is located.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The search keyword. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description:
The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID.

> This parameter cannot be used as a filter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise list-workspaces --already-joined true --search-key poc_test --biz-region cn-hangzhou --service-account-id 12345 --workspace-id 120000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --vpc-id vpc-bp10wnlcmor0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise ListWorkspaces --region cn-hangzhou --AlreadyJoined true --PageSize 10 --VpcId 'vpc-bp10wnlcmor0000' --PageNumber 1 --SearchKey poc_test --WorkspaceId 120000 --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --ServiceAccountId 12345
